items.title: The flow, not the headline: point-in-time LLM sentiment and the cross-section of cryptocurrency returns *
items.claim: Point-in-time LLM sentiment predicts next-day crypto returns at 21 bps daily with 2.21 Sharpe, serving as a veto not a tilt.

items.title: Monetary Policy Expectations of Sophisticated Investors
items.claim: Hedge fund monetary policy expectations predict yield curve moves, and funds with more accurate forecasts earn higher risk-adjusted returns.

items.title: FinForesight: A Diagnostic Backtesting Benchmark for Deep Research Systems in Financial Forecasting
items.claim: Pretraining-era benchmark scores exceed post-cutoff scores, but tighter retrieval controls narrow the gap between backtests and live results.

items.title: The Cryptocurrency Trend Factor Revisited: Predictive Information, Portfolio Construction, and Pricing Claims
items.claim: Comprehensive correction of the crypto trend factor eliminates its alpha and turns factor-substitution gains into significant declines.

items.title: TrackMem: Tracking Evolving Beliefs in Long-Horizon Financial Dialogue
items.claim: A per-speaker graph memory beats existing systems on revised-figure questions, reaching 73.9% accuracy versus 69.4% for the strongest baseline.

items.title: Herding or Racing? Decomposing Cross-Account Order-Flow Persistence in On-Chain Markets
items.claim: Most cross-account order-flow persistence on Uniswap is CEX price arbitration rather than herding, and this race flow drives most liquidity-provider losses.
